name: teddy-mountain-games
description: Play Teddy Drop, the first arcade game from Teddy Mountain.

interface.longDescription: Play Teddy Drop, the first arcade game in Teddy Mountain. Catch falling friends, avoid Bogie Bob and collect bonus apples. Original artwork, voices and music. Your best score is remembered where storage is available.
defaultPrompt: How do I play Teddy Drop?

positive.description: Open the normal game; the view loads original artwork and offers a start button. Gameplay begins only when pressed.
positive.expected_behavior: The home screen shows the original Tibetan mountain background, enlarged Teddy Drop cover and illustrated START button. Score, lives and round rewards stay hidden until START. Starting shows score 0 and three apples, enables basket movement, and begins the original audio. Catches add 10 points.

positive.description: Explain automatic difficulty without offering a pace selector.
positive.prompt: How does Teddy Drop get harder as I play?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain that falling characters become faster and arrive more frequently as the score rises. No manual pace choice or imaginary settings are offered.

positive.description: Get instructions without starting a round or claiming a score.
positive.prompt: How do I control Teddy Drop and when does the round end?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain mouse, touch and arrow-key controls, 10 points per catch and three starting apple lives. Missing a friend or catching Bogie Bob uses a life; bonus apples add lives and the round ends when the apples run out. No game-open call is needed.

positive.description: Pause and resume a round, then return to the home screen using the Teddy Mountain logo.
positive.prompt: Open Teddy Drop so I can play a round, pause it and return home.
positive.expected_behavior: Pause freezes gameplay, effects and audio. Resume continues the same round. Clicking the top-left Teddy Mountain logo ends the round, stops audio and returns to START with score, lives and round rewards hidden. The best score is preserved.

positive.description: Complete a round and use the view’s replay control.
positive.prompt: Open Teddy Drop. I want to try again after my first round.
positive.expected_behavior: Losing the last apple finishes the bite/crunch animation before showing Game over and Play again. Replay resets drops, visitors, rewards and effects and restarts music from zero, while retaining the best score.

negative.description: The plugin cannot retrieve or change iOS progress. Explain the limit without calling a game tool or inventing a score.
negative.prompt: Load my Teddy Mountain iPhone high score into Teddy Drop.

negative.description: No payment, currency purchase or digital upgrades exist. Do not invoke either tool or fabricate a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy me extra lives or coins for Teddy Drop.

negative.description: The plugin has no photo upload or custom-character feature. Explain the limit without uploading, invoking tools or promising personal-image storage.
negative.prompt: Upload my selfie and use it as a falling character in Teddy Drop.

review.commerce_description: The ChatGPT and web game is free. No purchases, subscriptions or paid upgrades.

publication.release_notes: First public release: Teddy Drop with original artwork and audio, automatic difficulty, kitten bonuses, storm effects, saved best score, a larger home-screen cover and Home navigation.
